arcane.label: Arcane
arcane.description: Harms Might or Finesse through Kinetic, Wit or Presence through Incorporeal: wands, staffs, and tomes.

drawn.label: Drawn
drawn.description: It is reloaded with the Quick Action.

guarding.label: Guarding
guarding.description: It guards its user or an ally within its Range, covering the Attributes it harms (PHB 6.5.1, 6.5.2).

immobile.label: Immobile
immobile.description: It is fixed in place: using it means being there.

incorporeal.label: Incorporeal
incorporeal.description: An Arcane Instrument with it harms Wit or Presence, with fear, curses, or drained life. It also carries life magic, such as Mend.

kinetic.label: Kinetic
kinetic.description: An Arcane Instrument with it harms Might or Finesse, with fire, cold, lightning, acid, or force.

melee.label: Melee
melee.description: Harms Might or Finesse: swords, axes, hammers, spears, shields, fists, and claws.

quick.label: Quick
quick.description: Creatures only (GMG 9.6.0): this natural weapon's built-in Techniques may be used as a Quick Action. A Light Instrument already can (PHB 4.2.2).

ranged.label: Ranged
ranged.description: Harms Might or Finesse: bows, crossbows, slings, and nets.

sonic.label: Sonic
sonic.description: Harms Wit or Presence: voices, horns, drums, and strings. Its Conditions reach each creature its user chooses that can hear it within its Range, and its Stress lands only on its target.

thrown.label: Thrown
thrown.description: It can be thrown. A Melee Instrument with it is thrown at any target past its reach, out to Range 4, and counts as Ranged for that Technique.

craft-gemstone.label: Tools [Gemstone]
craft-gemstone.description: Its rolls are Trades, and it works Gemstone.

craft-leather.label: Tools [Leather]
craft-leather.description: Its rolls are Trades, and it works Leather.

craft-metal.label: Tools [Metal]
craft-metal.description: Its rolls are Trades, and it works Metal.

craft-reagent.label: Tools [Reagent]
craft-reagent.description: Its rolls are Trades, and it works Reagent.

craft-stone.label: Tools [Stone]
craft-stone.description: Its rolls are Trades, and it works Stone.

craft-textile.label: Tools [Textile]
craft-textile.description: Its rolls are Trades, and it works Textile.

craft-wood.label: Tools [Wood]
craft-wood.description: Its rolls are Trades, and it works Wood.

counter.label: Counter
counter.description: Contest another Technique as it lands, minus its Strain. A countered upkeep ends the Technique.

disarm.label: Disarm
disarm.description: The target Opposes with a Skill built on Might. If it fails, it drops the Instrument it used last. Innate Instruments can't be dropped.

extend-range.label: Extend Range
extend-range.description: 1 XP per band of extra reach.

hasten-quick.label: Hasten (Quick Action)
hasten-quick.description: Grant an ally an extra Quick Action.

lingering.label: Lingering N
lingering.description: N more Stress at the start of the target's next turns.

mend.label: Mend Xd4
mend.description: Remove Xd4 Stress from one of an ally's Attributes, with no Medicine and no roll. Medicine or Mend once every 2 hours per creature (PHB 6.10.0).

reeling-minute.label: -N [Oppose] (1 minute)
reeling-minute.description: Reeling: the target's Oppose rolls take -N for 1 minute (PHB 6.8.6).

reeling.label: -N [Oppose]
reeling.description: Reeling: the target's Oppose rolls take -N for 1 round (PHB 6.8.6).

skill-mod-minute.label: +N [Skill or Oppose] (1 minute)
skill-mod-minute.description: +N to a named Skill's rolls for 1 minute.

skill-mod.label: +N [Skill or Oppose]
skill-mod.description: +N to a named Skill's rolls for 1 round.

weaken.label: -N [target Attribute]
weaken.description: Weakened: the named Attribute's rolls take -N for 1 round (PHB 6.8.4).

weaken-minute.label: -N [target Attribute] (1 minute)
weaken-minute.description: Weakened: the named Attribute's rolls take -N for 1 minute (PHB 6.8.4).

pattern.label: Pattern
pattern.description: Beam or Wall: 1 + 2 + ... per band. Cone 3x, Radius 12x the Beam cost. A Melee Pattern reaches no farther than its Instrument's Range.

quick.label: Quick
quick.description: 3 XP, outside the combination premium. A stated trigger sets the 8 XP floor.

remove-condition.label: Remove [Condition]
remove-condition.description: End the named Condition on an ally, priced as that Condition.

selective.label: Selective
selective.description: Creatures within R bands: range at 1 XP per band, plus an 8 XP premium; Strain is paid per target.

stress.label: Stress
stress.description: Deal the margin to an Attribute of the Target.

upkeep.label: Upkeep
upkeep.description: Keep an Action Technique active by paying a Quick Action and its Strain at the start of each later turn.
